page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.6xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance designed for applications demanding significant memory capacity relative to compute power. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 24 dedicated virtual CPUs running on 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processors built on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 192 GB of System RAM, corresponding to 8.0 GB of memory per core. This 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions the instance as a specialized platform for data-heavy compute tasks.

Network functionality is supplied by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth connection. The instance does not feature local storage disks, necessitating reliance on network-attached block storage for persistent data management. Additionally, the instance excludes discrete GPU acceleration. The lack of integrated local disks simplifies instance lifecycle management while focusing resources on high-density RAM.

From a cost efficiency perspective, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU allows organizations to scale memory-bound applications without over-allocating unused CPU capacity. The hardware configuration makes the instance suited for running large relational databases, in-memory caches such as Redis, enterprise resource planning systems, and real-time data streaming analytics.
